page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re4.10xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 40 dedicated vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 12.0 GB per core. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that require substantial RAM capacity relative to compute resources.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps. Because there are no local storage drives or hardware accelerators, this server is highly specialized for workloads that rely on external storage arrays and do not require GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re4.10xlarge offers a dense memory configuration per dedicated vCPU, making it a viable option for hosting large in-memory databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications where RAM capacity is the primary bottleneck. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, large-scale caching systems, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
